User Request: Show recent orders.

Dashboard Components:
Title: Recent Orders
Type: table
Description: List of recent orders with order ID, customer, order date, and total amount
Title: Total Orders
Type: metric
Description: Total number of orders placed in the last month
Title: Orders by Status
Type: pie_chart
Description: Distribution of orders by their shipping status
Title: Top Customers
Type: bar_chart
Description: Top customers by total order value in the last month

sql_queries.title: Recent Orders
sql_queries.description: List of recent orders with order ID, customer, order date, and total amount
sql_queries.sql: SELECT o.OrderID, c.CompanyName AS Customer, o.OrderDate, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalAmount FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN 'Order Details' od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY o.OrderID, c.CompanyName, o.OrderDate ORDER BY o.OrderDate DESC LIMIT 10

sql_queries.title: Total Orders
sql_queries.description: Total number of orders placed in the last month
sql_queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalOrders FROM Orders WHERE OrderDate >= date('now', '-1 month')

sql_queries.title: Orders by Status
sql_queries.description: Distribution of orders by their shipping status
sql_queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ShippedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Shipped' ELSE 'Pending' END AS Status, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount FROM Orders GROUP BY Status

sql_queries.title: Top Customers
sql_queries.description: Top customers by total order value in the last month
sql_queries.sql: SELECT c.CompanyName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalOrderValue FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN 'Order Details' od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE o.OrderDate >= date('now', '-1 month') GROUP BY c.CompanyName ORDER BY TotalOrderValue DESC LIMIT 5
